name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing, but through a fascination with engineering. Growing up in Johannesburg, he spent hours tinkering with engines, developing a keen understanding of mechanics and a meticulous eye for detail. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in quality control and materials science. He started his career at a local automotive manufacturer before transitioning to AF Corse, drawn by the challenge of maintaining the highest standards in a high-pressure environment. 

At AF Corse, Thabo has quickly established himself as a reliable and pragmatic member of the quality control team. His approach is methodical and data-driven, always seeking to identify potential issues before they escalate. He prides himself on his ability to remain calm under pressure and to communicate effectively with engineers and technicians. What sets Thabo apart is his proactive approach to problem-solving, always seeking out innovative solutions to enhance the team's performance and ensure the reliability of their racing vehicles.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neat fade with a sharp hairline.
physical.description: Thabo is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating his tools at the start of each shift, regardless of whether they need it.
